actualReports.method: Directly opened the real engine-generated redacted JSON as a local document; the product View Claw Report button and report export dialog were not exercised.

productReportControl.reason: The product report action invokes setup-engine.py report --run-id. Its default_state_root uses the OS account home from pwd.getpwuid, deliberately ignoring the disposable editor HOME. Actual qualification journals use separate explicit engine-*/state roots, which the product command cannot select. A faithful successful report-button pass would require copying journals into shared owner state, changing production state routing, or substituting the backend; none was done.

scopeLimits: This is local Mac acceptance, not WSL remote extension-host qualification.
The extension ran from reconciled source; packaged VSIX installation was not tested.
Draft creation and ownership restrictions used seeded synthetic drafts; channel selection and settings changes used actual webview controls and native VS Code prompts.
Actual runtime acquisition/configuration and pause/resume evidence is separate from these UI passes.
Configuration, authentication and transport in inspected reports retain the actual engine states; no authentication or delivery success is inferred.
Provider calls, model sessions, device reads, account pairing, messages, calls and meeting capture were not invoked.
